spans.text: [41] AR: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ EN: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -
[28] AR: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ EN: [Allah] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the warning.

folded.id: on|the|day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapi
folded.subject: On
folded.object: Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapi

spans.text: [44] AR: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌۭ EN: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapi

folded.id: on|the|day we will say to hell
folded.subject: On
folded.object: Day We will say to Hell

spans.text: [30] AR: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍۢ EN: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?"

folded.id: over what|they|say and exalt [allah] with praise of your lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting
folded.subject: over what
folded.object: say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting

spans.text: [39] AR: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ EN: So be patient, [O Muhammad], over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
[25] AR: مَّنَّاعٍۢ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍۢ مُّرِيبٍ EN: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
[11] AR: رِّزْقًۭا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ EN: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land.

folded.id: seated on|the|right and on the left
folded.subject: seated on

spans.text: [17] AR: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌۭ EN: When the two receivers receive, seated on the right and on the left.
All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
[5] AR: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍۢ مَّرِيجٍ EN: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.

folded.id: that is|the|day of [carrying out] the threat
folded.subject: That is

spans.text: That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.

folded.id: that is|the|day of emergence [from the graves]
folded.subject: That is

spans.text: That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
That is a distant return."

folded.id: that|is|what you were trying to avoid
folded.subject: that
folded.object: what you were trying to avoid

spans.text: [19] AR: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ EN: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.

folded.id: the day|they|will hear the blast [of the horn] in truth
folded.subject: The Day
folded.object: will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth

spans.text: [42] AR: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ EN: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth.
[12] AR: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ EN: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamud

folded.id: the word|will|not be changed with me
folded.subject: The word

spans.text: [29] AR: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٍۢ لِّلْعَبِيدِ EN: The word will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
[35] AR: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌۭ EN: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
This is the Day of Eternity."

[2] AR: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ EN: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.
[23] AR: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ EN: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."

folded.id: this|is|what you were promised - for every returner [to allah] and keeper [of his covenant]
folded.subject: This
folded.object: what you were promised - for every returner [to Allah] and keeper [of His covenant]

spans.text: [32] AR: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍۢ EN: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allah] and keeper [of His covenant]
Thus is the resurrection.
[43] AR: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ EN: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
[28] AR: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ EN: [Allah] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the warning.

[38] AR: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍۢ EN: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.

folded.id: we|know|what the earth diminishes of them
folded.subject: We
folded.object: what the earth diminishes of them

spans.text: [4] AR: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ EN: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
[3] AR: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌۭ EN: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]?

folded.id: when we|have|died and have become dust
folded.subject: When we

spans.text: [3] AR: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌۭ EN: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]?

[9] AR: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ مُّبَٰرَكًۭا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ EN: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest

[16] AR: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ EN: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein
[17] AR: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌۭ EN: When the two receivers receive, seated on the right and on the left.

folded.id: who feared|the|most merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance]
folded.subject: Who feared
folded.object: Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance]

spans.text: [33] AR: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍۢ مُّنِيبٍ EN: Who feared the Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].
[26] AR: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ EN: Who made [as equal] with Allah another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."
[18] AR: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌۭ EN: Man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
[4] AR: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ EN: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
[35] AR: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌۭ EN: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
